Class CborMediaTypes

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.serde.cbor.CborMediaTypes
public final class CborMediaTypes extends Object
Media type constants for CBOR.

When Micronaut Core introduces MediaType.APPLICATION_CBOR, this type remains a stable entry point and can alias the core constant without changing the media type string.

Since:
3.1.0
